experiment: H1: extra board danger under remaining observed incoming garbage
hypothesis: While observed garbage remains pending, penalize holes, covered depth and dangerous height more strongly. Cancellation lowers this extra pressure term.
baseline: BotConfig::legacy() with the common zero-gravity softdrop cost set to zero; original legacy evaluator weights otherwise unchanged.
candidate: The same baseline, changing only pending_safety from 0.0 to 1.0.

shared_protocol.rules: The same existing S2 movement, attack and cancellation engine for both sides
shared_protocol.node_accounting: Hard cap including evaluated nodes from an unpublished partial final expansion; terminal searches may leave unused budget.
shared_protocol.observation: Own board/current/hold/NEXT5/combo/B2B-Surge/observed incoming counts and activation/own history only
shared_protocol.hidden_inputs: No true future sequence, simulator RNG, opponent board or future attacks are passed to choose().
shared_protocol.future_search: CC2 SevenBag speculation beyond known preview, without a fixed-depth cutoff
shared_protocol.pairing: Each seed is played twice with baseline/candidate sides exchanged

control.note: These four control matches were reproduced in CI and locally; duplicates are counted once and excluded from strategy win rate.

decision.reason: All three disjoint batches favor the fixed candidate empirically. Retain as a candidate for subsequent comparison, not as conclusively superior. The final 200-game confirmation alone remains statistically uncertain.

sampling_note: The extra fixed 200-game confirmation was chosen after inspecting the weaker first validation. The coefficient and executable were not changed. Do not treat the pooled result as a pre-registered, optional-stopping-corrected significance claim, or treat two games in a seed as independent observations.
major_issues: Old duel omitted incoming from search and used Randomizer::Unknown, disabling speculation. Both sides now share pending-aware search and SevenBag speculation.

This is the shared zero-gravity alternating-lock arena: outgoing activates on receipt, with the existing per-nonclear garbage rise cap. Live travel and Surge activation timing are not simulated. Unknown-hole continuation uses the existing approximate scenarios. These are conditional arena results, not official-server win rates.
An initial u128 JSON duration reporting error was fixed before these scored batches; aborted pre-fix executions were not assigned winners.
